Messages.Author: Dasein
Messages.Body:
On Apr 15, 12:42 am, LSJ <vtes...@white-wolf.com> wrote:


Any particular reason why? I'm guessing because of the unwritten
(assumed) rule that says you can only play abilities that give you a
press during the press step. Seems logical, but I'm wondering whether
Flash at superior causes a problem.
I can play Flash at superior for a manuever AND a press during the set
range step.
If I can play effect X (Flash at super) for a press during that step,
why can't I play effect Y (Aeron's special) for a press during that
step?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


You don't get a press from Flash in the maneuver step. You get an optional press
for later.

Just as you can play Thrown Gate during the maneuver step (with a strike-choice
"for later"), but you can't play Thrown Sewer Lid during the maneuver step,
since that strike isn't "for later".

Similarly, Aeron's press isn't for later.
